notes.title: Quest for Conquest 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Alrighty, here's the list of all balance changes and fixes that we made with this update:

Balance

 Slightly reduced human armor and damage
 Increased Giant health and damage
 Increased food and other rewards at the start of the game
 Made the first area of the game slightly less punishing
 Increased combat difficulty in the last area
 Reduced rewards in the last area


Event fixes

 Fixed some events not properly transitioning to or from combat
 Fixed a row break issue that caused text to cut out early (Many events)
 Fixed other text issues


Store fixes and changes

 Changed material purchases from 10 gold for 10 materials to 5 gold for 5 materials
 Food-resource can't be bought anymore if it has reached max capacity
 Fixed the issue that caused some of the units to appear available for purchase, even when they actually weren't


Misc fixes and changes

 Esc button can be used to close status screen + map
 UI resource pop-up texts should display values with 3+ digits correctly
